prompt: A vintage vanity dresser in white with gold accents: a curved-front base with drawers, a large oval tilting mirror with a reflective material, a matching upholstered stool, and a few items on top (perfume bottles, a jewelry box, a small vase with flowers).

A classic camping lantern: a metal base with a fuel tank and valve knob, a glass globe with a glowing mantle that casts warm point light, a vented top cap, and a wire bail handle. It sits on a log with a flickering glow at night.

A skateboard with a maple deck with concave shape and kicked-up nose and tail, a colorful abstract graphic on the bottom (simple shapes only), grip tape on top, two metal trucks with bushings, and four urethane wheels. It flips over periodically to show the underside.

A stylized red fire truck: a crew cab, emergency light bar with flashing red lights, side compartments with roll-up doors, chrome ladders, hose reels, and a turntable ladder on top that raises and extends when a button is pressed.

A medieval stone castle gatehouse: two round flanking towers with crenellated battlements, an arched gateway with a portcullis that raises and lowers (button), a wooden drawbridge over a moat with water, arrow slits, and banners on poles.

A tranquil lotus pond: calm water with subtle ripples, large round lotus leaves floating and some standing above the water, pink lotus flowers in various stages of bloom, reeds along the edge, and two dragonflies darting around.

An open wooden music box: a polished box with a hinged lid, a brass cylinder with small pins, a steel comb with tuned teeth, a wind-up key on the side, and a tiny rotating figurine (simple abstract dancer shape) on top. The cylinder turns and pins pluck the comb teeth (visible deflection).

A colorful ceramic plate with three street tacos: soft corn tortillas folded around grilled meat, diced onions, cilantro, lime wedges, and salsa, plus a small bowl of guacamole and a few tortilla chips, on a woven placemat.

A two-level shopping mall atrium: a central open void with glass railings, escalators connecting the floors, storefronts with generic unbranded signs, a directory kiosk with a floor map, benches and potted trees, and a skylight above. Camera at 1.6 m eye height on the ground floor.

An original sleepy sloth character (not based on any existing IP): fuzzy brown body, a cream face mask with dark eye patches and a gentle smile, long arms with three curved claws, hanging from a tree branch with leaves. It slowly sways and occasionally yawns.
